founder.title: Meet Shlomo Dratler
founder.body: Shlomo Dratler is a North Miami Beach native who has spent years working in education and therapy. His approach emphasizes intrinsic motivation, self-awareness and practical responsibility. Jewish Leadership Fishing Academy brings that approach into hands-on fishing, meaningful relationships and Torah values.

faqs.q: Does my son need fishing experience?
faqs.a: No. Beginners are welcome. The Sunday lessons introduce the skills used on the Keys trip.

faqs.q: Does he need his own equipment?
faqs.a: Yes. Each boy needs his own rod, reel and tackle. We’ll guide you on what to buy before the lessons.

faqs.q: Where and when are the lessons?
faqs.a: Groups are organized by age and location. We’ll contact you with the schedule and location for your group.
We’ll follow up with group details. When dates and locations are confirmed, we’ll send payment instructions and the participation forms needed before your son joins.

By credit card online or in cash. Full payment is due by the end of the first lesson. A boy whose fee has not been paid cannot join the second lesson until full payment is received; cash can be paid at check-in before that lesson begins.

faqs.q: Can he bring a smartphone or tablet?
faqs.a: No. Smartphones, tablets and devices capable of playing or streaming videos are not permitted at any Academy group activity, even if filtered or offline. Games and dedicated gaming devices are permitted only when they cannot play or stream videos, and only when the instructor allows.

faqs.q: What happens if a boy breaks the rules?
faqs.a: An ordinary conduct breach receives one clear warning. A further breach leads to removal from the program. Serious unsafe behavior may require immediate removal. Fees paid for a participant removed for violating the Student Agreement are non-refundable, except where required by law.

Before your son’s first lesson, with no lessons attended, we retain a $100 administrative fee and refund the rest of the amount paid. After his first or second lesson and before the Keys trip, we retain $200 in total. For a fully paid $390 package, the refund is $290 before lessons begin or $190 after one or two lessons. Removal for misconduct follows the separate policy in the Program Terms.

faqs.q: What if my son is ill or misses a lesson?
faqs.a: Notify us at least 24 hours before the lesson starts. Your son will keep credit for that lesson, and we’ll try to arrange a suitable replacement as soon as possible, depending on availability.

faqs.q: What happens if the weather prevents the trip?
faqs.a: We will not depart while it is raining. If dangerous weather forces us to postpone, we’ll reschedule and preserve your son’s credit for the affected activity, without charging again for the replacement.

studentAgreement.title: Student Agreement
studentAgreement.intro: We want every boy to enjoy fishing, work together and take responsibility. Please read these expectations with your son before submitting this form.

sections.title: Respect and collaboration
sections.body: I will speak respectfully, work together with the group, and respect other people, their belongings and our shared equipment. Bullying, threats and deliberately hurting someone are not acceptable.

sections.title: Instructions and safety
sections.body: I will follow the instructor’s directions, stop immediately when told, and stay with the supervised group. I will use rods, hooks, tools and fish-handling equipment only as instructed. I will tell an adult when I need help or notice something unsafe.

sections.title: Phones, tablets and other devices
sections.body: I will not bring a smartphone, tablet, or device that can play or stream videos to any Academy lesson, trip, group journey or other group activity—even if it is filtered or offline. Games and dedicated gaming devices are permitted only when they cannot play or stream videos, and only when the instructor allows.

sections.title: Consequences
sections.body: For an ordinary conduct-rule breach, I will receive one clear warning. If I break the rules again after that warning, I will be removed from the program and may not return. Serious unsafe behavior or refusal to follow an immediate safety instruction may result in removal without a warning.

studentAgreement.acknowledgment: I have read and explained the Student Agreement to each son listed above, including the safety rules, device restrictions and consequences for breaking the rules.

programTerms.title: Program Terms

sections.title: Payment
sections.body: Payment is by credit card or cash. Full payment is due by the end of the first lesson. If payment has not been received, your son may not join the second lesson or any later activity until full payment is received. Cash may be paid at check-in before the second lesson begins. All required participation forms must be completed before the first lesson.

sections.title: Cancellation before the first lesson
sections.body: If you cancel before your son’s first lesson and he has not attended any lessons, we retain a $100 administrative fee and refund the rest of the amount paid for his package. If you paid the full $390, your refund is $290.

sections.title: Illness and missed lessons
sections.body: If your son is ill or cannot attend a lesson, notify us at least 24 hours before it starts. He will keep credit for that lesson and can attend a replacement lesson at no additional charge. We’ll try to arrange a suitable place as soon as possible, depending on availability.

sections.title: When a replacement cannot work, before any lessons
sections.body: If we cannot provide a replacement, or you cannot attend the replacement date, and your son has not attended any lessons, we retain a $100 administrative fee and refund the rest of the amount paid for his package. If you paid the full $390, your refund is $290.

sections.title: Cancellation after lessons begin
sections.body: If you withdraw your son after his first or second Sunday lesson and before the Florida Keys trip, we retain $200 in total and refund the rest of the amount paid for his package. If you paid the full $390, your refund is $190. The $200 is the total retained amount, not an additional charge on top of lesson fees.

sections.title: Weather and rescheduling
sections.body: We will not depart for the trip while it is raining. If a storm or other dangerous weather requires us to postpone a lesson or trip, we will reschedule it. Your son will keep credit for the affected activity or the portion we could not provide, with no additional charge for that replacement. We will contact you with the revised arrangements.

sections.title: Removal for misconduct
sections.body: If a participant is removed for violating the Student Agreement, fees already paid for that participant are non-refundable, including unused lessons or the trip, except where a refund is required by law.

sections.title: Privacy Notice
sections.body: Your family’s details are private. We use them to plan groups and contact you about the program.
